Priya — thanks for the ask and the raw log. We've started a short decision register and an initial timeline. I attached the CSV export of our timeline extract (incident-timeline.csv) and the short draft exec summary below.

Quick draft exec summary (for board use):
- Incident window: 2027-09-03T01:14Z — 2027-09-03T03:06Z
- Impact: ~18% of inference requests experienced elevated latency; automated fallback engaged for 90s; no data loss reported. Estimated customer-facing error rate: 0.6% for the window.
- Root cause (initial): regression in a cache eviction path triggered by a rare sequence of model compaction events under sustained batch pressure.
- Immediate mitigation: increased KV cache retention + temporary throttling of large-batch warmup jobs.
- Next steps (proposed): permanent fix for eviction ordering (engineering), expanded regression test for compaction scenarios (qc), update routing policy to fallback to a cheaper model variant when latency spike detected (runtime).

Proposal on SLA credits: recommend we hold on the formal credit request until we complete the RCA and quantify customer exposure; however, offer Atlas a good‑faith credit estimate in the QBR and pledge a firm timeline for a remediation release (target: two weeks).

Action items I propose we publish to the register for the QBR:
1) Decision: Public position on credits — Draft language (Naomi) — due Wed EOD
2) Owner: Remediation engineering ticket + PR (Vivek) — initial ETA Thu next week
3) Owner: Test coverage expansion (Jonas) — PR by next milestone
4) Owner: Postmortem + customer-facing FAQ (Hannah) — first draft Wed
